#include<stdio.h>
#include<string.h>
int main(){
    char w1[]="SAAB"; //silent   listen
    char w2[]="BAAS";
    int len1=strlen(w1);
    int len2=strlen(w2);
    int asciiarr[256]={0};
    if (len1!=len2){
        printf("Not Anagram");
        return 0;
    }
    int w1n,w2n;
    for (int i=0; i < len1;i++){       //hash table
       w1n= w1[i];
       asciiarr[w1n]++;       //hash table
       w2n = w2[i];
       asciiarr[w2n]--;
    }
    for(int j=0; j<256; j++){
        if (asciiarr[j]!=0){
        printf("Not Anagram");
        return 0;
        }
    }
        printf("Anagram");
    return 0;
}
Anagram
